title: com.pqt.pos.payment data
description: Money in for a sale or out for a refund (X1, B1). The amount is always positive; `direction` gives the sign. Allow-listed fields only: no customer identity, card numbers or free text (ADR-033).

billRef.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the bill number the payment settles or refunds with the store's key (ADR-033); never the real number.

paymentNo.description: Position of this payment within its bill (split tenders), for stable ids.

direction.description: in: received from the customer; out: refunded.

amountMinor.description: Amount in minor units, always positive.

providerRef.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the card, UPI or gateway transaction reference with the store's key (ADR-033); never the real number.
